caveat: Observed on ONE machine against ONE local engine build. Single-host evidence is not a platform matrix. This covers the engine and the modules the chat screen calls; it does NOT cover the authenticated browser UI, which requires a signed-in session.

steps.what: selectTier() picks a tier this machine can run

detail.because: This machine has 15.65 GB of memory and no dedicated graphics card, so OCADE selected the engine matched to that hardware. It downloads about 4.87 GB and runs entirely on this computer.

skipped.why: needs a dedicated graphics card; measured at under half the speed of a smaller model without one
needs a dedicated graphics card; measured at under half the speed of a smaller model without one

steps.what: remote ':cloud' aliases are excluded from on-device discovery
routeTask('general') chooses the device-matched engine, not merely the largest that fits

rejected.why: qwen3-coder:30b needs about 22.3 GB of RAM but only 13.4 GB of this machine's 16.8 GB can safely be used.
needs a dedicated graphics card; without one it is measurably slower than a smaller model
leaks its own reasoning into replies despite think:false, producing 274-448 tokens where other tiers use 50-56
profile "vision" is not suitable for general

detail.priorDefectMeasured: Before this policy was applied the router chose qwen3:14b on this same machine and took 184,260 ms to first token for a one-word answer.

steps.what: rollback targets the manifest's previous tier, and refuses when it is absent

rollback.reason: Going back to qwen3:4b, which was working before qwen3:8b.

refusedWhenTargetMissing.reason: The earlier model qwen3:0.1b-not-installed is no longer installed, so rolling back would leave no engine at all.
